name: Lingaraj Temple
description: One of the oldest and largest temples in Bhubaneswar, dedicated to Lord Lingaraj (a form of Shiva), and a leading example of Kalinga-style temple architecture.

name: Udayagiri and Khandagiri Caves
description: Twin hills with ancient rock-cut caves carved mostly during the reign of King Kharavela, used historically by Jain monks.

name: Dhauli Shanti Stupa
description: A white Peace Pagoda near the site of the Kalinga War, built by Japanese Buddhist organizations; also home to Ashokan rock edicts.

name: Jagannath Temple
description: One of the four Char Dham pilgrimage sites in India, famous for the annual Rath Yatra chariot festival.

name: Puri Beach
description: A popular golden-sand beach on the Bay of Bengal, known for sunrise views and its proximity to the Jagannath Temple.

name: Konark Sun Temple
description: A 13th-century UNESCO World Heritage Site built in the form of a colossal stone chariot dedicated to the Sun God.

name: Chilika Lake
description: Asia's largest brackish water lagoon, known for migratory birds (especially at Nalabana Bird Sanctuary) and Irrawaddy dolphins near Satapada.

name: Barabati Fort
description: A ruined fort on the banks of the Mahanadi River, once the seat of the Gajapati rulers of Odisha.

name: Daringbadi
description: Known as the 'Kashmir of Odisha', a cool hill station in the Kandhamal district with coffee plantations, waterfalls, and pine forests.

name: Similipal National Park
description: A tiger reserve and biosphere in Mayurbhanj district known for waterfalls, dense sal forests, and diverse wildlife including tigers and elephants.
best_time_to_visit: November to June (park typically closed during monsoon — verify official dates before visiting)
